###########################################################################
# ES focus queue - core effects (hand-written).
# Per-focus effects (es_fq_process_<id>) are generated by
# tools/focus_queue/generate.py into es_focus_queue_generated_effects.txt.
#
# Country state:
#   array    es_fq_queue          queued focus ids (see tools/focus_queue/focus_ids.json)
#   var      es_fq_order_<id>     1-based position shown on the tree button (unset = not queued)
#   var      es_fq_frame_<id>     button frame: 2 queued, 3 started by queue, 4 blocked
#   var      es_fq_running        id the queue started last (cleared when it leaves the queue)
#   var      es_fq_ui_revision    dirty counter for the scripted GUIs
#   flags    es_fq_open, es_fq_moving, es_fq_paused, es_fq_blocked, es_fq_hide_tree
###########################################################################

# Called once per day for every human-controlled country (see on_actions).
es_fq_daily_update = {
	add_to_variable = { es_fq_ui_revision = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			es_fq_supported = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = es_fq_paused }
			check_variable = { es_fq_queue^num > 0 }
			es_fq_idle = yes
		}
		es_fq_tick = yes
	}
}

# Walk the queue from the top: drop finished/invalid entries, skip entries whose
# requirements are unmet (marked as blocked), start the first startable one.
es_fq_tick = {
	clr_country_flag = es_fq_blocked
	clear_temp_array = es_fq_blocked_ids
	set_temp_variable = { es_fq_idx = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { es_fq_done = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { es_fq_done = 0 }
			check_variable = { es_fq_idx < es_fq_queue^num }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_head = es_fq_queue^es_fq_idx }
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_result = 0 }
		meta_effect = {
			text = {
				es_fq_process_[id] = yes
			}
			id = "[?es_fq_head|0]"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { es_fq_result = 2 } }
			# completed, tree changed or focus no longer exists
			remove_from_array = { array = es_fq_queue index = es_fq_idx }
			set_temp_variable = { es_fq_unmark_id = es_fq_head }
			es_fq_unmark = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { es_fq_result = 1 } }
			set_variable = { es_fq_running = es_fq_head }
			set_temp_variable = { es_fq_done = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = es_fq_blocked
			add_to_temp_array = { es_fq_blocked_ids = es_fq_head }
			add_to_temp_variable = { es_fq_idx = 1 }
		}
	}
	es_fq_reindex = yes
	for_each_loop = {
		array = es_fq_blocked_ids
		value = es_fq_bv
		meta_effect = {
			text = {
				set_variable = { es_fq_frame_[id] = 4 }
			}
			id = "[?es_fq_bv|0]"
		}
	}
}

# Rewrite the 1-based order numbers and button frames for every queued focus.
es_fq_reindex = {
	for_each_loop = {
		array = es_fq_queue
		value = es_fq_v
		index = es_fq_i
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_pos = es_fq_i }
		add_to_temp_variable = { es_fq_pos = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_fr = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { es_fq_running = es_fq_v } }
			set_temp_variable = { es_fq_fr = 3 }
		}
		meta_effect = {
			text = {
				set_variable = { es_fq_order_[id] = es_fq_pos }
				set_variable = { es_fq_frame_[id] = es_fq_fr }
			}
			id = "[?es_fq_v|0]"
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { es_fq_ui_revision = 1 }
}

# Forget the display variables of one focus. Input: temp var es_fq_unmark_id.
es_fq_unmark = {
	meta_effect = {
		text = {
			clear_variable = es_fq_order_[id]
			clear_variable = es_fq_frame_[id]
		}
		id = "[?es_fq_unmark_id|0]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { es_fq_running = es_fq_unmark_id } }
		clear_variable = es_fq_running
	}
}

# Add or remove one focus. Input: temp var es_fq_toggle_id. Used by the tree buttons.
es_fq_toggle = {
	clr_country_flag = es_fq_moving
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_array = { array = es_fq_queue value = es_fq_toggle_id } }
		remove_from_array = { array = es_fq_queue value = es_fq_toggle_id }
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_unmark_id = es_fq_toggle_id }
		es_fq_unmark = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { es_fq_queue^num < 100 } }
		add_to_array = { array = es_fq_queue value = es_fq_toggle_id }
	}
	clr_country_flag = es_fq_blocked
	es_fq_reindex = yes
}

# Remove one entry by index. Inputs: temp vars es_fq_remove_index, es_fq_remove_id.
es_fq_remove_at = {
	clr_country_flag = es_fq_moving
	remove_from_array = { array = es_fq_queue index = es_fq_remove_index }
	set_temp_variable = { es_fq_unmark_id = es_fq_remove_id }
	es_fq_unmark = yes
	clr_country_flag = es_fq_blocked
	es_fq_reindex = yes
}

es_fq_clear_all = {
	clr_country_flag = es_fq_moving
	for_each_loop = {
		array = es_fq_queue
		value = es_fq_cv
		set_temp_variable = { es_fq_unmark_id = es_fq_cv }
		es_fq_unmark = yes
	}
	clear_array = es_fq_queue
	clear_variable = es_fq_running
	clr_country_flag = es_fq_blocked
	es_fq_reindex = yes
}

# Move the picked entry (var es_fq_picked = focus id) to index es_fq_target.
es_fq_move = {
	set_temp_variable = { es_fq_source = -1 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = es_fq_queue
		value = es_fq_mv
		index = es_fq_mi
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { es_fq_picked = es_fq_mv } }
			set_temp_variable = { es_fq_source = es_fq_mi }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { es_fq_source > -1 }
			check_variable = { es_fq_target > -1 }
			check_variable = { es_fq_target < es_fq_queue^num }
		}
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { es_fq_source = es_fq_target } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { es_fq_neighbor = es_fq_source }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { es_fq_source < es_fq_target } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { es_fq_neighbor = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { es_fq_neighbor = 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { es_fq_displaced = es_fq_queue^es_fq_neighbor }
			set_variable = { es_fq_queue^es_fq_source = es_fq_displaced }
			set_variable = { es_fq_queue^es_fq_neighbor = es_fq_picked }
			set_temp_variable = { es_fq_source = es_fq_neighbor }
		}
		clr_country_flag = es_fq_blocked
	}
	es_fq_reindex = yes
}
